summary.text: Heather Hart is the Democratic candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 66, facing Republican incumbent Jackie Terribile in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is running to bring people together and build bipartisan support in Columbia.

paragraphs.text: Heather Hart earned a bachelor's degree from Taylor University in 2001 and a graduate degree from Northern Seminary in 2022.
Her career experience includes working as a writer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Hart said her family moved to the area six years ago and that she decided earlier in 2026 to run for the State House.

Hart said in the survey that her top priorities are protecting public education, strengthening public safety, fixing roads and infrastructure, and improving the cost and quality of living in South Carolina.
